title: Which sides do you add?
text: A rectangle has two lengths and two widths. The perimeter is $$8 + 5 + 8 + 5$$, or $$2 \times (8 + 5)$$. A common mistake is to multiply $$8 \times 5$$, which is the area, or to add $$8 + 5$$ only once. What is $$8 + 5$$?

title: Double that sum
text: Both pairs of sides are included when you multiply by 2. What is $$2 \times 13$$?

title: Worked solution
text: Perimeter $$= 2 \times (8 + 5) = 26$$. Common mistake: answering 40, the area, or 13, only half the boundary. General rule: the perimeter of a rectangle is $$2l + 2w$$. Area is a different measurement, $$l \times w$$, and it uses square units.
